evaluations.summary: Verdict: not ready for disbursement. The loan agreement 860001/26 is present and the recipient (Kavorin Rec s.r.o., IČO 98001001) matches the client record. The insurance vinculation and the guarantee declaration are complete. Still to fix: (1) the invoice FV-A-26-0001 and the proof of the VAT payment (367 290 CZK) have not been uploaded; (2) no recipient signature was detected on the order, the handover protocol or the security transfer; (3) the security transfer is signed by only one SGEF signatory instead of two. Other observations: in the payment agreement (09_Dohoda_o_zaplaceni) only the provider's signatures were detected, and none for the seller or the buyer; this document does not count as payment proof.

Verdict: not ready for disbursement. Missing: the invoice FV-A-26-0003 and proof that the buyer paid the VAT (322,980 CZK). The handover protocol was uploaded but failed processing and cannot be read, so it must be uploaded again. The security transfer has only one SGEF signature (Radovan Veleš), so the second signatory must sign. On the order, the buyer's signature was not detected as the recipient's, so it needs a visual check. Loan agreement, recipient match (Zelmoris Rec s.r.o., 98001205), guarantee and insurance vinculation passed. Other observations: in the payment agreement only provider signatures were detected (seller and buyer blocks not detected), and parties, serial number HX26000003 and amounts are consistent across documents.

Verdict: not ready for disbursement. Not uploaded: the supplier's invoice with its specification including the serial number, the bank statement proving the VAT payment of 340 200 CZK, and the confirmation that the supplier has been paid apart from the loan amount. The agreement's recipient IČ is the placeholder "YYYYYYY". Deficient documents: the handover certificate has no parties, date, condition or signatures; the order is mostly illegible (confidence 0.55) and not confirmed by the supplier; the security transfer has empty party blocks and no contract number, asset, serial number or value; the guarantee has no body text (secured contract, scope, commitment) and only one SGEF signature. Other observations, not counted in any rule: the agreement names the provider "SGX Finance Czech Republic s.r.o." with DIČ "XXXXXXX"; the supplier appears as "Epirock s.r.o." (IČ 06493399) in the agreement but "EPORIC Czech republic s.r.o." (IČ 06493394) in the order; the order is issued in the name of "SMOLO Recycling s.r.o." (IČ 04606884) and shows a different bank account; Petr Fiala signs for the recipient, while the client record lists only Jiří Labuda as authorized; the payment agreement is blank; an insurance vinculation was uploaded although the agreement does not require one.

The case is not ready for disbursement: two required documents are missing. The loan agreement 860001/26 is present, and its recipient (Kavorin Rec s.r.o., IČO 98001001) matches the client record. The order, handover protocol, insurance vinculation, security transfer and Kavorin Holding a.s. guarantee are uploaded. Still needed: (a) invoice FV-A-26-0001 and (d) proof of the VAT payment of 367 290,00 CZK; the Dohoda o zaplacení only describes how payment will be made and does not prove it was paid. No other discrepancies were found in the documents reviewed: supplier, order and invoice numbers, serial number and amounts are consistent.

Verdict: not ready for disbursement. Two required documents are missing: the supplier tax document/invoice (item a) and the bank statement proving payment of 340 200,00 CZK VAT (item d). The loan agreement is present and the recipient (SOLOM Rec s.r.o., IČO 04606812) matches the client record. Other discrepancies to review: (1) the supplier is "Epirock s.r.o." (IČ 06493399, C 283051) in the agreement but "Epiroc Czech Republic s.r.o." (IČ 06493394, C 283050) in the payment agreement; (2) the payment agreement and the guarantee declaration refer to loan no. 17023644/25, not 170170/25; (3) Petr Fiala signs for the recipient with no function stated, but the client record lists Jiří Labuda (jednatel) as the authorised signatory, and the guarantee for SOLOM a.s. is signed by Herbert Jitka ("Vedoucí"); (4) the handover protocol has no readable text and the order's text is sparse, so their contents could not be verified.

Two of three rules passed and one failed. The loan agreement 170170/25 is present, and its recipient (SOLOM Rec s.r.o., IČO 04606812) matches the client record. Two documents required before disbursement are missing: (a) the supplier's tax document or invoice and (d) proof of the 340 200 CZK VAT payment. The handover protocol has no readable text and the order is only partly readable, so their contents could not be checked. Other observations, not counted in any rule: (1) The supplier is "Epirock s.r.o., IČ 06493399, C 283051" in the agreement but "Epiroc Czech Republic s.r.o., IČ 06493394, C 283050" in the payment agreement. (2) The payment agreement (section 1.2) and the guarantee declaration both cite loan no. 17023644/25 instead of 170170/25. (3) Petr Fiala signs for the recipient with no function given, while the client record lists Jiří Labuda (jednatel) as the authorized signatory. (4) Herbert Jitka signs the guarantee for SOLOM a.s. with the function "Vedoucí", and his authority is not verified.

Verdict: not ready for disbursement. The loan agreement 170170/25 is present, but the recipient IČ in it is the placeholder "YYYYYYY" instead of 04606812. Two required documents are also missing: the supplier invoice/tax document (item a) and the bank statement proving the VAT payment of 340 200,00 CZK (item d). Other observations (not counted in any rule): the provider is named "SGX Finance Czech Republic s.r.o." with placeholder DIČ "XXXXXXX" on page 1, but "SG Equipment Finance" in the signature block; the supplier is written "Epirock s.r.o." while the manufacturer is Epiroc; the agreement's signatories (Jan Kovák, Josef Jonák, Petr Fiala) and the guarantor's signatory (Herbert Jitka) do not include the client's authorized jednatel Jiří Labuda; the handover protocol and the payment agreement have no readable text, and the order has only partial text.
